primary_source_receipts.claim: Share of US households qualifying as accredited investors in 2022
primary_source_receipts.finding: About 24.3M households (18.5%) qualified in 2022 under all prongs; 12.5% under the net-worth prong; 8.8% excluding retirement assets; available before publication.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Kitces median 30-year ending wealth under 4% rule
primary_source_receipts.finding: Median ending wealth almost 2.8x starting principal for 60/40 with inflation-adjusted 4% withdrawals; some starting years (1929, 1937, 1965, 1966) ended below principal.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Goldman Sachs share of $500K+ earners living paycheck to paycheck
primary_source_receipts.finding: 36.6% in GSAM 2026 survey fielded July 2026 (after publication), loose definition; an October 2025 Fortune piece suggests earlier similar Goldman findings; narrator 40% UNVERIFIED.

primary_source_receipts.claim: CFA Institute Monte Carlo 44% of millionaires end in poverty
primary_source_receipts.finding: No CFA Institute source found; UNVERIFIED.

primary_source_receipts.claim: SCF 2022 net worth percentiles for $1M and top 1%
primary_source_receipts.finding: Unofficial figures: 90th percentile about $1.92M, 99th about $13.7M; official percentile for $1M UNVERIFIED.

calculation_receipts.method: End-of-month $2,750 contributions, monthly compounding at 7%/12 (narrator real rate) and 10%/12; simple ratios
